about: Budgets for `node scripts/bench-startup.mjs --check`. A metric's limit is reference x ciScale x headroom, for wall time and for CPU time. Lower a reference when a change makes something faster; raise one only with the reason in the commit that raises it. CPU time has a 10 ms clock tick, so a limit below minLimitMs is raised to it.

calibration.machine: WSL2 x86_64, taskset to 2 cores, node v24.19.0, built output of main at 5f29783af
calibration.method: node scripts/bench-startup.mjs --check, three full runs; each reference is the largest of the three medians (median of 5 samples per run), rounded up to the next 10 ms. ciScale 3 is a first, deliberately loose figure: no CI runner has been measured yet, so re-derive it from the first runs on the matrix leg
calibration.resumedSession: 400 turns of one question and three 1.5 KB answers, 2,400 log records, 3.3 MB
